summary.en: Team8 is an Israeli cybersecurity/enterprise-tech 'foundry' (venture studio) founded in 2014 by former Unit 8200 leaders. It builds companies in-house and also invests via Team8 Capital; over its first decade it spurred ~20 companies and invested in ~21 others, including Claroty, Sygnia, Illusive Networks and Hysolate, with AUM well over $1B.

summary.en: Kamet Ventures is a venture builder created in 2016 with an initial €100m commitment from insurer AXA. From offices in Tel Aviv, London and Paris it ideates and builds companies from scratch in InsurTech, Digital Health and Mobility; it reports 25+ startups launched and $1.8b+ total portfolio valuation.

strategy.thesis: Company builders 'before we are investors': AnD supports pre-seed ventures through an in-house Studio model (market validation, team-building, network, fundraising) and seed companies through its fund.

summary.en: AnD Ventures is a Herzliya-based Israeli firm (founded 2020) that brands itself 'company builders before we are investors.' It builds pre-seed startups in-house through its Studio (typically $100K–$200K) and backs seed companies via its $70M Fund I ($1M–$3M checks). Portfolio includes Onebeat, Conntour, Qualifire and Ludeo.

strategy.thesis: A FoodTech 'venture creation'/venture-studio operated by Strauss Group under the Israeli Innovation Authority incubator program: rather than scouting existing companies it scouts scientific breakthroughs and IP, then recruits founders and builds new FoodTech companies in-house.

program.eligibility: Early-stage FoodTech / AgriFoodTech innovations and scientific breakthroughs

summary.en: The Kitchen FoodTech Hub, founded in 2015 by Strauss Group under Israel's Innovation Authority incubator program, runs a 'venture creation' / venture-studio model: it starts from market needs and scientific IP, recruits founders and builds FoodTech companies in-house over a two-year plan funding each $650K–$750K. It launched alt-protein leaders Aleph Farms and Imagindairy and raised a $70M fund.
summary.local: The Kitchen Hub הוא חממת פודטק שהוקמה ב-2015 על ידי קבוצת שטראוס במסגרת תכנית החממות של רשות החדשנות, הפועלת במודל 'יצירת מיזמים' (venture studio) ובונה חברות פודטק מאפס. בין בוגריה: Aleph Farms ו-Imagindairy.

strategy.thesis: A company builder led by Waze co-founder Uri Levine that co-founds startups from inception using its 'PCM Method' (validate the problem, select a strong CEO, mentor), serving as co-founder and active board member from brainstorming through seed and follow-on rounds. Most of its startups are homebrewed in-house.

summary.en: The Founders Kitchen is a Tel Aviv company builder founded in 2019 by Waze co-founder Uri Levine. Using its 'PCM Method' it co-founds startups from inception, mostly homebrewed ideas, acting as co-founder and active board member through seed and follow-on rounds. Portfolio includes Pontera, SeeTree and Oversee.

summary.en: eHealth Ventures (eHV), founded in 2014 and based in Tel Aviv, is a digital-health technological incubator and fund manager that builds early-stage Israeli digital-health companies from ideation to commercialization. Backed by Maccabi, Amgen, the Mayo Clinic and others, it raised a $30M fund (target $40M) and has a portfolio of roughly 15-24 companies.

summary.en: FutuRx is an Israeli biotech incubator (founded 2014, Ness Ziona) that forms early-stage therapeutics companies in-house under the Innovation Authority program. strategy.thesis: A founder-operator-led venture builder for early-stage Israeli consumer startups targeting the US market, combining capital with hands-on operational support across go-to-market, product, marketing, operations and team-building.

summary.en: Beyond22 is a Tel Aviv- and New York-based venture builder (founded 2024) for early-stage Israeli consumer startups targeting the US. Led by founder-operators Suf Kletter and Omer Sher, it pairs $100K–$750K investments with hands-on operational support; 972VC classifies it as 'Venture Builder · Venture Capital'.
